adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is constructed as `eventType.destinationCalendar ? [..] : organizerUser.destinationCalendar ? [..] : null` (so it can be `null`). Immediately after, for COLLECTIVE team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If neither the event type nor organizer has a destination calendar but other collective hosts do (populating `teamDestinationCalendars` from `users.slice(1)`), the optional-chained `push` is skipped and those host calendars are never added. This is a concrete, diff-visible behavior gap affecting the intended multi-host calendar handling.
